data.one_liner: Image and video preview gallery supporting zoom, drag, and hero transitions
data.what_it_does: Provides a gallery component for displaying images and videos with support for two-finger zoom, double-click to zoom, left and right swiping, gesture-based dismissing, and automatic video pausing.
use_when: You need a full-screen image and video preview gallery with zoom and pan capabilities.
You want to support smooth Hero transitions from a grid view to a full-screen gallery.
avoid_when: You only need a simple inline image viewer without full-screen gallery capabilities.
You require a complex media player with custom video controls.
strengths: Supports both image and video previews in a single gallery.
Built-in gestures like pinch-to-zoom, double-click to zoom, and gesture back navigation.
Automatically pauses videos when they lose focus.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic README and example app.
Dependent on specific Flutter versions (requires Flutter 1.20.0 or higher).
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 1.20.0 or higher since it is based on InteractiveViewer.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick photo_view if you need a dedicated, highly customizable photo viewing and zooming widget without the built-in multi-media gallery setup.
